name: Yoshioka Mari
source:
Star Sign: Virgo
Job: Publisher
Hobby: Making Candy
Likes: Apricot Tea
Dislikes: The Smell of Tobacco

A former coworker of the protagonist and still a good friend of hers.
She has a calm personality and no matter who she's around she still keeps up her cute womanly atmosphere.
She's the one who recommended that the protagonist should work at the bar Casina.
